headline: How an OpenAI influencer trip backfired
summary: OpenAI's influencer brand trip faced significant backlash. The all-expenses-paid event triggered criticism and envy among creators. Critics questioned the trip's frivolousness and marketing ethics.

summary: The Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS is now at its lowest price. This gaming handheld offers a great deal amidst rising storage costs. Originally over $1,100, it's significantly discounted.

headline: ‘Not healthy’ LLM use is more common than you think
summary: Popular YouTuber Hank Green is stepping back after AI use criticism. Green described his LLM usage as 'not healthy,' using it for research. His admission sparked a significant debate about AI ethics.

headline: BMW’s in-car Spider-Man ad is villain behavior
summary: BMW drivers are receiving unwanted Spider-Man movie ads in their cars. A 'special surprise' turned out to be a commercial on the dashboard. Many owners view this unsolicited advertising as unacceptable.

headline: Amazon Has a Well-Reviewed 12V 4,000A Cordless Car Jump Starter for Just $25.64 After Coupon
summary: A powerful 12V 4,000A cordless car jump starter is on sale. It's available on Amazon for only $25.64 after a coupon. The device is capable of jump-starting most cars and trucks multiple times.

headline: Capcom Is Making a Life-Sized Leon Kennedy Statue for Resident Evil’s 30th Anniversary, and of Course the Internet Is Being Totally Normal About It
summary: Capcom is commissioning a life-sized Leon S. Kennedy statue. The statue celebrates Resident Evil's 30th anniversary exhibition. The internet is predictably buzzing about the beloved character's tribute.

summary: A Dungeons & Dragons and World of Warcraft crossover is launching soon. The highly anticipated collaboration arrives this November. Preorders for the new D&D and WoW product are now live.

summary: New deals include Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake. Grab a discounted LEGO Mineral Collection and Zelda Art Book. Save on PS5 and PC games, plus a $9 GameSir controller.

headline: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
summary: Video shows a Russian drone pursuing a Ukrainian street vendor. Ukraine condemns the incident as a 'human safari' war crime. The terrified civilian was hounded by the remotely-controlled drone.

headline: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
summary: Over 170 migrants were rescued from a burning boat in the Channel. They were attempting to cross to the UK when the fire broke out. The government confirmed all migrants will be returned to France.

headline: Afghan boxer arrested in Greece over discovery of Scottish woman's body in suitcase
summary: An Afghan boxer was arrested in Greece in connection with a body. The body of a Scottish woman was found in a suitcase. Sharif Ahmadzai is expected to appear in an Athens court soon.

headline: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
summary: Oil prices have dropped amid hopes of the Strait of Hormuz reopening. US officials announced progress in talks to resume shipments. Secretary Rubio and Treasury Secretary Bessent led the negotiations.
